title: Concord K8s Job Environment Contract
description: Defines all environment variables injected into validation/manufacturing K8s jobs. Used by create_kubernetes_job() for validation and by the runner for preflight checks.

CONCORD_SESSION_ID.description: Unified session ID (SessionV2.id). The reporter uses this as the target for all callbacks.

CONCORD_SESSION_TYPE.description: Session type. Determines reporter endpoint behavior.

CONCORD_API_URL.description: Base URL for the Concord HTTP API (e.g., 'http://concord-http-api.staging.svc.cluster.local:9001').

CONCORD_API_KEY.description: Ephemeral API key (24h TTL) for reporter callbacks and artifact access.

CONCORD_API_HOST.description: Host header for ingress routing when API URL uses an IP address.

PRODUCT_SLUG.description: Product slug (e.g., 'alpha'). Used to fetch product metadata from the API.

BOARD_NAME.description: Board revision name (e.g., 'alpha_b0'). Derived from manifest if not set.

TEST_PACKAGE_VERSION.description: Test package version to download from MinIO (e.g., '1.0.0' or 'dev-abc12345').

TEST_PACKAGE_TYPE.description: Package type. Determines MinIO storage path prefix.

STAGE.description: Validation pipeline stage to run (e.g., 'smoke', 'regression', 'fuota'). Not set for manufacturing (all steps run).

PYTEST_FILTER.description: Pytest -k filter expression for selective test execution.

PYTEST_MARKER.description: Pytest -m marker expression for selective test execution.

PIPELINE_ID.description: BuildRun ID for firmware artifact resolution via StageAssets.

FIRMWARE_SET_ID.description: Pinned FirmwareSet ID (overrides PIPELINE_ID when set).

MTIB_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated MTIB gRPC addresses (host:port). One per fixture slot.

MTIB_PORT.description: Default gRPC port (used when MTIB_HOSTS entries don't include port).

SLOT_SNRS.description: Comma-separated J-Link probe serial numbers, aligned with MTIB_HOSTS.

SLOT_DEVICE_IDS.description: Comma-separated CoreCloud device IDs, aligned with MTIB_HOSTS.

FIXTURE_ID.description: Fixture DB ID for session tracking and fixture locking.

FIXTURE_PROFILE_PATH.description: Path to single-slot fixture profile JSON inside the container (validation).

FIXTURE_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to multi-slot fixture config JSON inside the container (manufacturing). Contains slot definitions with per-slot MTIB addresses.

DEVICE_IMEI.description: Pre-known IMEI for the DUT (single-slot). Avoids modem shell read during personalization.

DEVICE_ICCIDS.description: Pre-known ICCIDs for the DUT (single-slot). Comma-separated if multiple SIMs.

CORECLOUD_DB_ENV.description: CoreCloud environment namespace key. Selects which VAL_*_DB_* and VAL_*_API_* vars to read.

COREOPS_SERVER_URL.description: CoreOps API server URL for device personalization (e.g., 'https://10.4.45.3:443').

LOKI_URL.description: Loki push endpoint for centralized log aggregation.

STORAGE_URL.description: MinIO endpoint URL (FQDN for cross-namespace access).

ARTIFACTS_DIR.description: Directory for writing test artifacts (UART logs, screenshots).

CONCORD_RUN_ID.description: Legacy session ID field. Use CONCORD_SESSION_ID instead.

MTIB_ADDRESS.description: Single MTIB address. Use MTIB_HOSTS (comma-separated) for multi-slot support.

MTIB_HOST.description: Single MTIB host. Use MTIB_HOSTS (comma-separated) for multi-slot support.

DEVICE_SNR.description: Single device SNR. Use SLOT_SNRS (comma-separated) for multi-slot support.

DEVICE_ID.description: Single device ID. Use SLOT_DEVICE_IDS (comma-separated) for multi-slot support.
